an4.59:1.1: Bhojanaṃ bhikkhave dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṃ imāni cattāri ṭhanāni deti.
an4.59:1.3: Āyuṃ deti, vaṇṇaṃ deti, sukhaṃ deti, balaṃ deti, sukhaṃ deti.
an4.59:1.4: Āyuṃ kho pana datvā āyussa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassā vā,
an4.59:1.5: vaṇṇaṃ datvā . . . sukhaṃ datvā . . . balaṃ datvā balassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
an4.59:1.6: Bhojanaṃ bhikkhave dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṃ imāni cattāri ṭhānāni detīti. 2.
an4.59:2.4: āyuñ ca vaṇṇañ ca sukhañ ca balañ ca
